sources.entry: Cloudlog - Log your amateur radio contacts anywhere. (Source Code) MIT PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Cloudlog is a self-hosted PHP web application for logging amateur radio contacts from any browser.
summary.what_it_does: Cloudlog is a self-hosted PHP application for logging amateur radio (ham radio) contacts, accessible from any web browser with an internet connection. It is built on CodeIgniter 3 with a Bootstrap 5 frontend, and uses HTMX for AJAX requests and jQuery for some frontend behavior. The README requires a Linux server running Apache (Nginx reported to work) with PHP 8.5 and MySQL 5.7 or higher. Installation details are on the project wiki rather than in the README. The README also describes a Docker Compose development environment (copy .env.sample to .env, then docker-compose up) and end-to-end Cypress tests. Microwave QSO logging requires a 64-bit operating system.
use_cases: track ham radio QSOs from a browser
log microwave QSOs on a 64-bit system
run a personal amateur radio log on my own server
how_to_run: Set up a Linux server with Apache (or Nginx), PHP 8.5, and MySQL 5.7+
Follow the installation guide on the project wiki
Development only: npm install cypress, then npx cypress run for end-to-end tests
notable: Browser-based logbook for amateur radio contacts, with no desktop client needed
Community-contributed codebase started by Peter Goodhall (MM9SQL)
Docker Compose dev environment provided for development, not production
caveats: The README says the project does not provide Docker support for production and will not handle Docker-related support requests
Requires Linux, a web server, PHP 8.5, and MySQL 5.7+; setup is handled through the wiki
Only accepts pull requests on the dev branch and asks for single-feature PRs
The project is developed in the maintainer's free time; hosted service is offered for a fee (£4 per month at time of README)
